notice: Producer research decision only. Independent review and owner adoption remain separate.
rationale: I read the complete held working text of the order, both history observations (a 2026-10-15 Federal Register API disposition note and a 1989 printed codification row), and the acting text. The two observations are editorial leads and are not the basis; the basis is the acting instrument's own held text. EO 12221 (signed 1980-06-27, 45 FR 44249; the held pages also carry unrelated neighbouring documents) has one operative paragraph that amends Section 8 of Executive Order No. 12044 of March 23, 1978 so that the order expires on April 30, 1981 unless extended. It is a sunset amendment to 12044 with no independent command, so it lives with 12044. Executive Order 12291 (signed 1981-02-17, held text of the February 19, 1981 Federal Register) section 10 revokes Executive Orders No. 12044, as amended, and No. 12174, with no delayed effective date for that section in the held text; the revocation of 12044 as amended extinguishes the amended sunset clause. The clause therefore ended 1981-02-17, before its own April 30, 1981 expiry date; even on the sunset reading it ended on or before 1981-04-30. The 2026-10-14 cutoff is long after either. No earlier ending located in held texts; savings checked: none.
